+"""Directed tangent-rotation loss with hard nearest-codebook assignments."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Compute the masked directed tangent-margin loss.
+
+    Nearest-code indices are selected by Euclidean distance and are discrete;
+    gathering keeps the selected code values differentiable.
+    """
+    eps = float(parameters.get("eps", 1e-8))
+    margin = float(parameters.get("margin", 0.1))
+    weight = float(parameters.get("weight", 0.01))
+    mask = mask.to(device=source.device, dtype=source.dtype)
+
+    # Selection is intentionally non-differentiable; selected code vectors are not.
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        source_idx = torch.cdist(source.detach(), codebook.detach()).argmin(dim=1)
+        target_idx = torch.cdist(target.detach(), codebook.detach()).argmin(dim=1)
+    c_source = codebook[source_idx]
+    c_target = codebook[target_idx]
+
+    u_raw = c_source - source
+    v_raw = target - source
+    u = u_raw / (torch.linalg.vector_norm(u_raw, dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
+    v = v_raw / (torch.linalg.vector_norm(v_raw, dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
+    tangent = v - (u * v).sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True) * u
+    delta = c_target - c_source
+    score = (delta * tangent).sum(dim=-1)
+    per_pair = F.softplus(margin - score)
+    # Mask before reduction; denominator is the full batch so all-masked is exact zero.
+    return weight * (per_pair * mask).mean()
